findings.summary: Format now runs while holding the logger mutex, serializing formatting across goroutines and reducing throughput under contention; a custom Formatter that logs via the same logger or calls SetFormatter/SetLevel will deadlock.
Test goroutines are never waited on (no sync.WaitGroup), so the test can return before they run, making the race tests flaky detectors rather than reliable regression tests.
The comment 'logging before SetReportCaller ...' was copy-pasted into TestEntryFormatterRace where it should refer to SetFormatter, and is duplicated in TestEntryReportCallerRace.
TestEntryFormatterRace writes to the default os.Stderr and relies on -race being enabled to catch anything.
